phases.goal: Use exact task-language VLA to grasp or move the stapler toward the cyan mat.
phases.name: move_stapler_to_mat
phases.verify: Stapler visibly moves under control and the cyan mat remains the target support.

phases.goal: Release, clear the gripper, and re-observe the stapler relative to the mat footprint.
phases.name: release_and_verify_pad
phases.verify: Stapler is resting on the mat or is close enough for a small current-state correction.

phases.goal: If release leaves the stapler biased near an edge, use only small observation-bound nudges before final release.
phases.name: edge_correction_if_needed
phases.verify: Stapler is fully inside the cyan mat footprint after the final release.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Stapler is visibly controlled before transport is trusted.
Mat footprint is rechecked after release and gripper clearance.
Any correction is a small current-observation nudge, not a clean-coordinate replay.

roles.arm: left arm handles stapler in the source trace

task_language: Drop the blue stapler for paper fastening onto the Cyan mat.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 3:release(arm=left); 4:move_to(arm=left,gripper=open,orientation=keep); 5:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 6:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 7:move_to(arm=left,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 8:move_to(arm=left,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 9:move_to(arm=left,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 10:release(arm=left); 11:move_to(arm=left,gripper=open,orientation=keep); 12:move_to(arm=left,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 13:release(arm=left). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: The selected success already preserves terminal capability through observation-rebound, staged move_to corrections and release checks. Use rotate_wrist only when current orientation evidence requires it, and do not replay retired actions.
